U_MCU - RP2040

USB computer control; generates STEP/DIR.
Checks PD voltage before enabling the motor.
Internal regulator supplies the 1.1 V core.
U_FLASH - GD25Q16EEIGR

2 MB external QSPI flash stores firmware.
Required because RP2040 has no internal flash.
BOOT pads permit ROM USB boot recovery.
Y_MCU - ABM8-272-T3

12 MHz crystal is the USB clock reference.
Load capacitors and XOUT resistor support
oscillation and limit crystal drive.
U_PD - CH224K

15 V request: CFG1=0, CFG2=CFG3=1.
PG is open-drain, active low. PD-only mode:
chip DP/DM shorted; VBUS sense pin unused.
U_BUCK - AP63203WU-7

AP63203 supplies 3.3 V logic and buzzer pulses.
4.7 uH Bourns, 10 uF/50 V input, 3x22 uF outputs.
Ripple, startup, biased capacitance and thermal tests pending.
U_DRV - A4988

Fixed 1/16 microsteps; enable/sleep defaults off.
6.2k/1k REF and 0.24 ohm shunts: 0.239 A nominal.
Calibrate actual phase peaks to <=0.25 A.
U_ESD - USBLC6-2SC6

Clamps ESD on USB D+ and D- at the data port.
VBUS pin references the protection diodes.
Q_DATA - MMBT3904-7-F

Detects host 5 V without direct GPIO feed.
10k base feed and 10k 3.3 V collector pull.
DATA_PRESENT LOW means host attached.
D_STATUS - green LED
1k series resistor; active-low MCU status indication.
U_TEMP - TMP102

Local PCB temperature, I2C address 0x48.
5.1k bus pull-ups, 10k ALERT pull-up and 100nF bypass.
Not a motor winding or driver junction measurement.
BZ_ALARM / Q_BUZZER

MLT-5020 driven at 4 kHz, 50% PWM through AO3400A.
100R gate, 100k pull-down, flyback diode, 22uF bypass.
Default off; PD-only short bursts, firmware required.
